name: convergence-gap
description: Two-neuron gap diffusion converges to v_A(t) = 0.5 (1 + exp(-2 g t)) as dt shrinks.
derivation: With identity local dynamics the scheme keeps a + b = 1 and multiplies a - b by (1 - dt g)/(1 + dt g) per step, so a_n = 0.5 (1 + ((1-r)/(1+r))^n). The script computed the errors for dts 0.1, 0.05, 0.025 (ratios about 0.25, the scheme is better than first order here) and checked max_ratio and max_error_finest.
